name: Shri Ujjwal Deorao Nikam
education: B.Sc., LL.B. Educated at M.J. College, Jalgaon and Law College, Jalgaon, Maharashtra
permanent_address: 54, Govindas Road, near Ruparel Law College, Mahim, Mumbai- 400016 (Maharashtra) 400016; W-54, Cooperative Housing Society, Matunga, West Mumbai 400019
social_activities: As an Advocate and Special Public Prosecutor (SPP), has been working on restoring public faith and confidence in the rule of law by relentlessly fighting for justice against all odds; apart from serving the legal field, also associated with many cultural, social and educational institutions; as a dedicated BJP karyakarta, actively engaged in building national unity and integrity
hobbies: Reading books, gardening yoga and gym
countries_visited: U.K., to attend court proceedings on behalf of India; U.S.A, as a sole representative from India for participating in the seminar by United Nations (UN) Security Council at New York for bringing the Terrorist to Justice, December 2010; the Netherlands, representing India at a Seminar by International Center for Counter Terrorism at Hague, the Netherlands, 2011; Pakistan, as a Member of Official delegation of Government of India to Islamabad, Pakistan for reviewing the case filed by FIR against the perpetrators of terror attack in Mumbai
other_information: Worked as Professor for mercantile law in one of the eminent Universities of Maharashtra; was Dean, Faculty of Law, North Maharashtra University; was Director, Board of Union Bank of India, 2001-2004; Member, West Zone Advisory Board of Life Insurance Corporation of India, 2001-2003; Awarded (i) Daksh Nagarik by Citizens of Nagpur, 2004, (ii) Maharashtra State Idol Award by Maharashtra Times, 2006, (iii) Rashtra Seva Puraskar by Manibhai Desai Pratisthan, 2006, (iv) Samaj Shree by Business Enterprise, Sangli, 2006, (v) Jiva Mahale Puraskar by Pratap Gad Samiti, Wai, Satara, 2007, (vi) Top Marathi Achiever by Maharashtra Times, 2007, (vii) Charitrya Puraskar, Pune, 2008, (viii) Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Bheem Ratna Award, Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar, (ix) Freedom Fighter Undhalkar Award for social work, 2009, (x) Best Advocate in State Award by Star Majha- News, 2010, (xi) Suryadutt National Award, Pune, 2010, (xii) Maharashtra Ratna by Zee TV and Daily Newspaper DNA, 2010, (xii) Doctorate by University of Pune, Maharashtra, 2011 and (xii) Padma Shri, 2016; contested the 2024 Lok Sabha Elections as a BJP candidate from Mumbai North Central constituency; has successfully prosecuted numerous cases, on request of the State Government; notably recognized for successfully seeking the highest number of life imprisonments and death sentences in the country; on the request of State Government, conducted several, prominent among them are (i) Kalyan local railway bomb blast trial, 1991, (ii) Bombay bomb blast trial, 1993, (iii) Twin bomb blast at Gateway of India and Zaveri Bazaar, 2003, (iv) Gulshan Kumar murder, 2003, (v) Nadeem extradition, London, 2004, (vi) Khairlanji dalit massacre case, Bhandara, 2006, (vii) Gangster Abu Salem case, 2006, (viii) Terror attack on Mumbai on 26th November, 2008, (ix) Multiple murder of children (bal hatyakand, Kolhapur), 2010, (x) Shakti Mill gangrape case, 2010, (xi) David Headley trial, 2016, (xii) Rathi murder trial, Pune, (xiii) Terrorist and LeT operative Abu Jundal trial, (xiv) Kopardi rape and murder trial, (xv) Sonai dalit hatyakand trial and (xvi) National level tennis player Karthik Raj murder trial
